name: ridean
description: Ridean — premium mobility platform: API, website, PWA, admin and mobile app

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ridean/api && npm run build -w @ridean/website && npm run build -w @ridean/pwa && npm run build -w @ridean/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @ridean/shared && npm run test -w @ridean/api
